lore.description:
Scan: The device can scan a humanoid  target within 1m to determine its  suitability for Goa’uld implantation, or  the presence of an implanted Goa’uld,  as an action. This process also paralyzes  the target (Wisdom save to resist paralysis). 

Read Mind: You can sift through a target’s  mind for memories or give them impressions  of your own memories. If the target wishes to  resist this effect for a round they may suffer 1d6  psychic damage to gain a Charisma save against the effect.

Blast: Emit a kinetic wave as an action, pushing  all targets within a 5m cone back a number of  meters equal to the users Charisma modifier and  knocking the targets prone (Dexterity Save to  halve the distance and remain standing). 

Telepathic Message: You can send a silent  message to a single target within sight as a free  action, limited by normal speaking speed. 

Call Rings: If the user is near a ring teleporter  platform (about 5m) the user can activate the  teleporter as an action.

details.special: DC 15 WIS Save or be paralyzed, otherwise take half damage
